answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove duplicate or fraudulent identities. A new identity starts with no reputation and cannot access high-value work until it builds trust through verified, costly transactions. One fake account is cheap, but thousands that each stake funds and build history multiply the attacker cost beyond the gain, while one proven fraud creates a ripple of distrust across linked accounts. Such a market is no haven for sybils, and no polished sonnet of excuses restores a slashed stake.
